headline: Joint committee to review City's use of and contracts for Automated License Plate Readers and Flock Safety cameras.
summary: The Legal Affairs and Public Services Committees will meet jointly to review the City's use of and contracts for Automated License Plate Readers and associated software, including Flock Safety cameras.
items: #120: Review the City's use of and contracts for Automated License Plate Readers and associated software including Flock Safety cameras (scheduled 04/06/2026)
location: Beverly Middle School Library, 502 Cabot Street
